heading: HOW IT WORKS
subtitle: Easily create custom t-shirts, hoodies, polos, hats & more online.

steps.title: Order Online
steps.description: We've made it super easy to create your custom order. Upload your own images or logo, which will be added to your product.

steps.title: Expertly Printed
steps.description: Once you've placed your order, you can leave the rest to us. We're experts in our field and stand behind every product that leaves our facility.

steps.title: Delivered To You
steps.description: You have too much to do to worry about your t-shirts. We ship them directly to your door, or we will deliver in person, depending on distance, so you can use that time elsewhere.
